summary: Tested NEW feature 'Riepilogo Compensi Annuale - Export XLSX range custom'. Backend: 7/7 pytest pass on /api/admin/compensation-summary/default-range and /api/admin/compensation-summary/export-xlsx (admin success, season 2025/2026 default, XLSX content-type + content, Fede Rica €17.000 verified, 11 data rows, =SUM formulas, separate 'Esterni nel Range' column, threshold flags €5K/€15K, 400 invalid range, 400 invalid format, 403 non-admin, 401 no-auth). Frontend (Expo web static build): admin/index card 'Riepilogo Compensi Annuale — Esporta XLSX per il commercialista (range custom)' visible, clickable (data-testid=compensation-export-menu-card works). Modal opens with title '📊 Esporta Riepilogo Compensi', badge '🏆 Stagione 2025/2026', Dal=01/07/2025, Al=30/06/2026 pre-populated, green 'Scarica XLSX' + 'Annulla' buttons, and footer informativo with the quartili rule. Date validation: when Al < Dal the error 'La data di fine deve essere successiva alla data di inizio' is shown and download is blocked.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py L27867-27903 _calculate_person_range_total: clamp contract on range then iterates month-by-month with weekly-quartile rule. Edge case correctly handled (effective_end < effective_start returns 0). Solid.

L27906-27956 default-range endpoint: correctly determines current season based on today() vs season_start_month/day and supports non-solar (e.g. luglio→giugno) by branching e_month<s_month. Returns {start_date, end_date, label}. OK.

L27959-28085 export-xlsx endpoint: multi-tenant society_id filter ✓, separate column for 'Esterni nel Range' (NOT summed to total) ✓, sums external_total per anno solare toccato (years_in_range loop), includes coach/dirigente/collaboratore/admin from users + athletes PRO, ordered by cognome/nome. Good.
L28116 (TOTALI row): uses =SUM(G5:G15) formula range that is hard-coded to the current row count; works because computed dynamically against actual data row span. Confirmed via XLSX inspection.
Athlete PRO with missing contract dates correctly emits 'Date contratto incomplete' note and 0 total instead of error. Good UX.
Server.py is 31000+ lines — pre-existing technical debt flagged in iteration_70, still pending. Out of scope for this feature.

Frontend CompensationExportModal: validation error 'La data di fine deve essere successiva alla data di inizio' is local-only (blocks submit). Backend also returns 400 if it slips through. Defense in depth — OK.

success_rate.frontend: 100% - all modal elements, pre-populated dates, badge, buttons, footer, and validation work

seed_data_creation: None — used existing data of Pallavolo Perugia SSD. XLSX includes 11 compensated persons (Fede Rica coach 01/09/2025–30/06/2026 @1700/mese = €17.000 verified ✓).

Default for Pallavolo Perugia (1/7→30/6) = Stagione 2025/2026. The compensation-export-menu-card uses data-testid which is preserved in DOM.
